samples.question: Thick black line-work on a white canvas separates the picture into white regions. Every white region that is part of the outer background reaches the edge of the picture; exactly one white region is completely sealed off by black line on every side and never touches the picture edge. Four small coloured dots (red, green, blue, orange) each sit in one of the white regions. Which coloured dot lies inside the completely sealed-off white region? Choose: red, green, blue, or orange.
